record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Open conjectural lower bound for the stationarity pattern from Question 3.
record.original_question: Is it true that if there exists even a single set A⊆ω of the kind described in Question 3—namely, A contains infinitely many successor pairs n,n+1 and omits infinitely many successor pairs n,n+1—and the corresponding set S_A is stationary, then there is an inner model with a strong cardinal?

evidence.quote:
As a lower bound, in Question 3, current methods lead us to believe the
following conjecture (we have an as yet unchecked proof based on the sketch
below):
Conjecture: If for a single A as in Question 3, SA is stationary, then there
is an inner model with a strong cardinal.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC. Recall the Foreman–Magidor notion of mutual stationarity: given a sequence ⟨κ_n : n < ω⟩ of regular uncountable cardinals and a sequence ⟨T_n : n < ω⟩ with T_n ⊆ κ_n, the sequence ⟨T_n⟩ is mutually stationary if for every algebra (structure with countably many finitary functions) on a set containing sup_n κ_n there exists an elementary substructure N of size ℵ_0 such that sup(N ∩ κ_n) ∈ T_n for every n < ω.

Specialize to κ_n = ℵ_n (so n ≥ 1). For each set A ⊆ ω with 0 ∉ A, define a stationary "cofinality pattern" by
   T_n^A = { α < ℵ_n : cof(α) = ℵ_0 }    if n ∈ A,
   T_n^A = { α < ℵ_n : cof(α) = ℵ_{n−1} }  if n ∉ A (and n ≥ 2),
and ignore n = 0,1 as needed. Say that S_A is stationary to mean that the sequence ⟨T_n^A : 2 ≤ n < ω⟩ is mutually stationary in the above sense.

Restrict attention to those A ⊆ ω that contain infinitely many "successor pairs" (i.e., infinitely many n with both n ∈ A and n+1 ∈ A) and also omit infinitely many successor pairs (i.e., infinitely many n with both n ∉ A and n+1 ∉ A).

Question. Is the following true? If there exists even a single such set A ⊆ ω for which S_A is stationary, then there exists an inner model containing a strong cardinal.
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is stated as an unverified conjectural lower bound (with only a sketched, unchecked proof) in Welch's 2005 commentary on open problems in mutual stationarity. Subsequent literature on mutual stationarity at the ℵ_n (e.g., Koepke–Welch, and later work by Adolf, Ben-Neria, and others) discusses related consistency strength bounds, but no published source confirms the specific lower bound of an inner model with a strong cardinal from stationarity of S_A for a single such A. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Global square and mutual stationarity at the ℵ_n
status_evidence.snippet: Studies mutual stationarity at the ℵ_n and related consistency strength questions.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work addresses mutual stationarity at ℵ_n but does not resolve the specific lower-bound conjecture.
